title: Checkout error taxonomy and instrumentation
description: Make checkout failures measurable by normalizing reason codes and emitting checkout_error events. Acceptance: Every checkout failure has a reason code; admin shows ranked error causes for last 7 days.

title: Checkout mobile layout optimization
description: Reduce mobile drop-off by improving spacing, stacking, and CTA visibility. Acceptance: No clipped content or overlapping controls on tested widths; mobile completion improves from Week 1 baseline.

title: Fee breakdown readability pass
description: Improve confidence and comprehension in pricing summary with clearer label hierarchy. Acceptance: Users identify net amount quickly in usability pass; no terminology mismatch between checkout and admin.

title: Projection copy and assumption consistency audit
description: Ensure scenario-based return language and assumption controls are consistent across surfaces. Acceptance: No fixed-return language remains; assumption help text matches across pages.

title: CTA hierarchy refactor on fund/dashboard mobile
description: De-crowd action controls by grouping secondary actions and preserving primary action clarity. Acceptance: Primary action is always obvious; tap misfires reduced in QA walkthrough.

title: UX copy standardization (errors + confirmations)
description: Standardize confirmation and error language and remove technical backend phrasing. Acceptance: Copy review passes for touched flows; no raw backend error strings shown to end users.

title: Stripe checkout preflight endpoint
description: Add preflight validation to prevent avoidable checkout session failures. Acceptance: Invalid requests fail preflight instead of checkout creation; frontend shows specific remediation message.

title: Baseline conversion dashboard and report
description: Publish weekly conversion scorecard with starts, completes, failure reasons, and device split. Acceptance: Week 2 scorecard published and repeatable; rates tie back to tracked events.
